title: 课程对齐度测量：基于CS2013与CS2023的纵向框架
summary: 提出一种人机协作的管道，通过语义检索与人工判断，测量计算机科学课程对国际课程指南（CS2013/CS2023）的覆盖程度。实验表明，该程序覆盖约50%的知识单元，且十年间保持稳定。在能力表述和认知深度方面，新指南提高了期望值，导致深度覆盖出现差距。该工具可复用。
summary_en: Proposes a human-in-the-loop pipeline using semantic retrieval and human judgment to measure a CS program's coverage of international curricular guidelines (CS2013/CS2023). The program covers ~50% of knowledge units, stable over a decade. A gap in cognitive depth reflects the new guideline's raised expectations, not program decline. The tool is reusable.
